description: One guild's roster, bosses killed, loot awarded, raid attendance and average item level, as that guild's own officers chose to publish them. Only uploads from officers holding a verified grant for the guild count, and a figure is public after 2 of them agree. Names are in-game character names, never accounts or real-world identities. A character's owner can opt out, and an opted-out character is left out of the roster, loot and attendance. A guild whose officers have not published gets an empty board; the tool does not look up other players or guilds. The average names how many roster members were measured; there is no combined score. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.
name: guild_board

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

gearCoverage.description: Roster members with one agreed item level, over the agreed roster.

ladderProgression.description: Per instance, newest first: bosses killed out of the instance's bosses, each kill with its date and who reported it. Members' kills and the officers' board together; a boss both report is one line.

list.description: Every boss of the instance in encounter order, killed or not.

killedAt.description: The earliest agreeing report, ISO; null for an unkilled boss or one only the officers published.

source.description: Who reported the kill; null for an unkilled boss.

overall.description: Rank among every guild in that instance.

realm.description: Rank among the realm's guilds in that instance.

ranks.description: Rank on the realm and overall in the newest instance with a kill; null without one.

seenRoster.description: Characters the addon saw in this guild, newest first: sightings, not the game's roster. Null when the player pages are not connected, which is not an empty guild.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: Guild board its officers published
